summary: Georgia resident, environmental studies major, former military wife, experienced homelessness, mother of two special needs children, advocate for digital independent workers, critical of UBI, strong beliefs in personal agency and choice, frustrated with sexism and classism, engaged in local community efforts, has a blog on homelessness and public policy, identifies as a woman, has a history of academic success, involved in discussions about poverty and mental health, critical of societal attitudes towards car ownership and public transit.
